scripts.text:
[Han]
There must be a ton of monsters
attacking the center of Prontera.
***
scripts.translation:
[韩]
普隆德拉中心一定正遭到大量魔物的袭击。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
My family...My friends...
They're all there...
I must protect them...
But...I have an even more important
job to do here...
scripts.translation:
[韩]
家人...朋友...都在那里...我必须保护他们...
可我在这里还有更重要的任务...

scripts.text:
[Han]
I, scientist Doyeon, can do it.
I can obliterate that dirty source place,
ceaselessly spawning the monsters...
That's why I'm protecting him.
***
scripts.translation:
[韩]
我相信科学家道渊能做到，摧毁那个不断涌出魔物的肮脏源头...
所以我要保护她。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
Protecting him and destroying this fortress
is what ultimately protects my family
and friends.
scripts.translation:
[韩]
保护她，摧毁这座要塞，才是真正保护我的家人和朋友。

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Can this scientist you're seeing here
really protect Prontera?
Can she?
Do you believe so?
scripts.translation:
[德克]
眼前这个科学家，真的能保护普隆德拉？
她能做到吗？你相信？

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Honestly, I don't...
But...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
说实话，我不太相信...
但是...

scripts.text:
[Doek]
All my loved ones were...
...by those monsters....
scripts.translation:
[德克]
我所有的亲人都...
...被那些魔物夺走了...

scripts.text:
[Doek]
This is the last hope I can have...
This is the last.
So please help me.
Help Doyeon...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
这是我最后的希望...最后的希望。
所以请帮帮我，帮帮道渊...

scripts.text:
- And then, she remained silent -
- for quite a while. -
scripts.translation: - 随后，她沉默了很久。-

scripts.text:
- It's full of items
so you can't proceed to conversation. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续对话。-

scripts.text:
- You should be level 145 or higher
to proceed. -
scripts.translation: - 你需要达到145级才能继续。-

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I'm just an ordinary scientist
teaching children and doing research.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我是住在普隆德拉的普通科学家，平时教孩子们知识，做些研究。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
But now...the life at least as I know it
has become shattered.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
但现在...我熟悉的生活已经彻底破碎。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Thanks to this fortress
looking like a huge trash can,
our village has turned into a trash heap
that doesn't even decay.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
都怪那座像大垃圾桶一样的要塞，把我们的村子变成了连腐烂都不会的垃圾堆。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Buildings fall down,
people keep dying out...
I have to wonder what the nobility and soldiers at the Prontera Palace
are up to when things are like this.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
房屋接连倒塌，人们不断死去...
都这样了，普隆德拉王宫里的贵族和士兵到底在干什么？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
A ton of undead monsters kept swarming about
from that entrance seen behind me
as if the sap monster spits out the sap.
They kept coming out
no matter how many were killed.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
大量不死魔物从我身后的入口涌出，就像树液怪不断吐出树液一样。
无论消灭多少，都没完没了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I suppose the monsters are being made up
inside the fortress.
My guess is that if we can defeat their ringleader in the fortress,
the monsters will get away
and Prontera will become stabilized.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我怀疑魔物是要塞里制造的。
如果能打倒里面的首领，魔物也许就会消失，普隆德拉也能安定下来。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
So I really wanted to enter the fortress
but couldn't find any entrance.
I studied day and night
and finally located it.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我想进要塞，却始终找不到入口。
日夜研究，总算找到了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so, a lot of magic
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
进入要塞得先启动传送门，为此需要大量魔力！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
所以...我一直在积攒传送门所需的魔力。
现在只缺一位勇士，去摧毁要塞，让普隆德拉恢复和平。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I'm just an ordinary scientist
teaching children and doing research.
And then...things came up
in Prontera all of a sudden....
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我是住在普隆德拉的普通科学家，平时教孩子们知识，做些研究。
可突然间，普隆德拉出了事...

scripts.text: About Sky Fortress
scripts.translation: 关于天空要塞

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation: 进入天空要塞

scripts.translation: 结束对话

I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I teach children and perform research activities.
But it has become
so dangerous there,
so I moved in here.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我是普隆德拉的科学家，平时教孩子们知识，做些研究。
可那里实在太危险，我才搬到这里。

scripts.text: About Sky Fortress
scripts.translation: 关于天空要塞

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation: 进入天空要塞

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
But now...my normal life
has become shattered.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
但现在...我平静的生活已经彻底破碎。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Thanks to this fortress
looking like a huge trash can,
our village has turned into a trash heap
that doesn't even decay.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
都怪那座像大垃圾桶一样的要塞，把我们的村子变成了连腐烂都不会的垃圾堆。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Buildings fall down,
people keep dying out...
I have to wonder what the nobility and soldiers at the Prontera Palace
are up to when things are like this.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
房屋接连倒塌，人们不断死去...
都这样了，普隆德拉王宫里的贵族和士兵到底在干什么？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
A ton of undead monsters kept swarming about
as if the sap monster spits out the sap.
They kept coming out
no matter how many were killed.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
大量不死魔物不断涌出，就像树液怪吐出树液一样。
无论消灭多少，都没完没了。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I suppose the monsters are being made up
inside the fortress.
My guess is that if we can defeat their ringleader in the fortress,
the monsters will go away
and Prontera will become stabilized.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我怀疑魔物是要塞里制造的。
如果能打倒里面的首领，魔物也许就会消失，普隆德拉也能安定下来。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
So I wanted to enter the fortress
but couldn't find any entrance.
I studied day and night
and finally located it.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我想进要塞，却始终找不到入口。
日夜研究，总算找到了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so, a lot of magic
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
进入要塞得先启动传送门，为此需要大量魔力！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
That's why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
所以...我一直在积攒传送门所需的魔力。
现在只缺一位勇士，去摧毁要塞，让普隆德拉恢复和平。
这就是我守在这里的原因。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To operate the warp,
a lot of magic is required.
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
That's the only way to open
the warp to the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
启动传送门需要大量魔力。
别忘了带来“地下城通行证”，只有这样才能打开通往天空要塞的传送门。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Show the -Dungeon Pass-.
scripts.translation: 出示“地下城通行证”

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
Enter the Sky Fortress
and help us save
the invaded Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
别忘了带来“地下城通行证”，进入天空要塞，帮我们拯救沦陷的普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I don't think this works
without the -Dungeon Pass-.
I can't open the warp without it.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
没有“地下城通行证”可不行，我没法打开传送门。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Oh! Where did you
get the -Dungeon Pass-?
This item is enough
to open the warp.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
哦！你从哪儿弄到的“地下城通行证”？
有这个就能打开传送门了。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Activate the warp.
scripts.translation: 启动传送门

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Are you not going
to help Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
你不想帮助普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
There! I opened the warp
to the Sky Fortress!
The warp will be activated
only for a limited period of time.
Step inside it, quick!
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
好了！通往天空要塞的传送门打开了！
只能维持一会儿，快进去！
